summary:
# The World Ended Once. It Didn't Finish the Job.

Three thousand years ago, an unknowable energy surged through the fabric of space and triggered **The Great Collapse**. Timelines shattered. Worlds overlapped. Entire realities were erased. Not destroyed, not damaged. Erased. Our world survived. Barely.
